articles.title: Meteors in the Morning? How to Catch the Secret Daytime Sky Show!
articles.summary: Most meteor showers happen at night, but the Arietids peak right before sunrise this week. You can even hear them on a regular FM radio!

articles.title: A Mountain of Secrets: How a Rocky Ridge in the Desert Tells Stories of Ancient Oceans and Early Humans
articles.summary: Jabal al Fāyah in the UAE was once under the sea. Now it's a desert ridge full of fossils and stone tools, showing humans lived there over 200,000 years ago.

articles.title: What If You Could Taste Colors or See Music? Meet Synesthesia!
articles.summary: Synesthesia is when your senses get mixed up—like hearing a sound and seeing a color. About 4% of people have it, including famous artists like Billie Eilish.
